name: get_full_system_config
description: Get the full system configuration: subsystem states (INSTEON/Z-Wave/Zigbee/Matter enabled/connected), PLM info, firmware/software versions, available upgrades, and other passive system facts (e.g. 'Node Property History Enabled'). No params. Cheap and side-effect-free -- call it freely for any question about system state/versions/subsystem status, not just while troubleshooting. This is also the mandatory first step (together with get_core_services_status, in the same turn) before any INSTEON diagnostics -- see get_diagnostics_prompt.
